definitions: A hollow container used to give shape to molten or liquid material when it cools and hardens.
A furry growth of minute fungi occurring in damp warm conditions, especially on food or other organic matter.
A distinctive type, style, or character.
Loose earth or soil, especially when rich in organic matter.
examples: Pour the jelly into the mould.
There was mould on the old bread.
He was cast in a different mould.
The gardener turned over the rich mould.
